user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search results and navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and compliance of pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-triggered actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits web pages initiated directly by user requests or GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated requests; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content potentially contributing to AI model training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to user queries in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-initiated requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Content indexed specifically to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and analysis
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token Googlebot

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google products
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and image features in Google Search
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token Googlebot-Image

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for Google products
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token Googlebot-Video

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News
user_agents.scope: Google News product including news.google.com and the Google News app
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token Googlebot-News

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl surfaces for Google Shopping
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token Storebot-Google

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools in Search Console
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token Google-InspectionTool

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal R&D and fetching publicly accessible content
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible site content used across various Google product teams
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token GoogleOther

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetching publicly accessible image URLs for research and development
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token GoogleOther-Image

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetching publicly accessible video URLs for research and development
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token GoogleOther-Video

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token Google-CloudVertexBot

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Standalone control token for Gemini model training and grounding
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt using user-agent token Google-Extended

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index web data automatically to deliver search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index web information in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Apple products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for search results in Spotlight, Siri, and Safari, and AI outputs.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled data to train Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Data crawled by Applebot used for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays app or website title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models or directly indexing products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches individual links at user request to help AI complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages for Bing search and Microsoft AI features.
user_agents.scope: Public web content used for Bing search and Microsoft generative AI experiences.
user_agents.opt_out: Specify Disallow directives for User-agent: Bingbot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates real-time snapshots and previews of web pages.
user_agents.scope: Web pages requested for Bing search previews.
user_agents.opt_out: Specify Disallow directives for User-agent: BingPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling to improve products, services, and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or page-level robots meta tags like noarchive.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content to appear in search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives specified for Amzn-SearchBot or general search bots.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information on the user's behalf.
user_agents.scope: Live information fetching initiated by users; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives, though user-initiated actions may not follow all directives.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated Nutch-based web crawler providing copy of internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Crawls random sample of the web and extracts crawl candidates using Map-Reduce.
user_agents.opt_out: Set Disallow: / in robots.txt for User-agent: CCBot, or join opt-out registry.
